summary.text: Larry Luick is a Republican state senator from District 25 in Fairmount who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A farmer and excavation contractor, he chairs the Senate Agriculture and Veterans Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: Larry Luick earned an associate degree in diesel mechanics from the North Dakota State College of Science.
His professional experience includes work as a farmer and as an excavation contractor.

Luick's legislative biography lists service as a board member of Red River Human Services, vice chairman of the National Conference of State Legislatures Agriculture Task Force, and a member of the Knights of Columbus.
It also lists eight years as president of the Fairmount public school board, and says he is married with five children.
Ballotpedia lists his Senate tenure as beginning in 2010.
His 2025 assignments include the Judiciary Committee and the Agriculture and Veterans Affairs Committee, which he chairs.
